metadata.selectionPolicy: Use a full-coverage acquisition during or no more than 48 hours after the verified event window; preserve orbit and polarization for the dry baseline.
metadata.dryBaselinePolicy: Median of same relative orbit/direction/polarization acquisitions from June through October preceding the event.
metadata.maskMethod: 30 m focal-median VV/VH change detection; require VV drop >=2.0 dB and VH drop >=1.5 dB.
metadata.unknownCriterion: no timely acquisition, insufficient valid coverage, permanent-water overlap, or ambiguous flood fraction

events.exclusionReason: No full-coverage Sentinel-1 acquisition during or within 48 hours after the event; nearest post-event acquisition was about four days later.
